testResults.name: focused-rca-handoff-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/thesis/rca/ tests/thesis/protected/
testResults.result: 72 tests (20 new): the handoff bundle assembles exactly the eight policy-approved payload sections content-addressed against the release manifest (AC1); the RCA response schema admits only candidate explanations, evidence, uncertainty, alternatives, and discriminating tests and structurally rejects strategy edits, parameter recommendations, and promotion decisions fail-closed (AC2); advice egress routes through the release filter plus verbatim-run and web-query linkage checks and provenance-references artifacts by digest (AC3); the revision handoff records protected-result diagnosis consumption, the strongest selection/reuse modifier, barred sealed-window reuse, and required new lineage/contract versions with allowed grades exploratory and historical_validation only (AC4)

testResults.name: wave-integration-suite
testResults.result: 2230 passed, 13 skipped, 1 xfailed at wave edit freeze

testResults.name: lint-and-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check . && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check . && uv run --extra dev ty check
testResults.result: ruff check, ruff format --check, and repository-wide ty clean

limitations: RCA response rejection is schema-shape only; detecting change-imperative intent in natural-language values is a later semantic layer
The egress verbatim-run check uses a structural 24-character overlap threshold against released artifacts rather than semantic quotation detection
